metadata.division: DIVISION 4-3-1. PURPOSE AND APPLICATION OF ARTICLE

content.title: 4-3-1-2. Application of article.
content.summary:
A.	General Standards. The standards of Division 4-3-2, General Standards for Site Design, set out design objectives for all new development and redevelopment.
B.	Specific Standards.

faqs.a:
A.	General Standards. The standards of Division 4-3-2, General Standards for Site Design, set out design objectives for all new development and redevelopment.
B.	Specific Standards. The standards of Division 4-3-3, Standards for Specific Development Types, set out design requirements for specific types of developments, as identified in each Section within the Division.
